authorityMonitoringLaw.principle: Authority-Level Monitoring Law: Monitoring is organized per recruitment authority, not per mission.
authorityMonitoringLaw.routingMechanism: Document Intelligence pipeline scans authority surfaces (advertisements, syllabi, press notes, PYQ archives, answer keys) and routes discovered documents downstream to matching canonical missions using configurable pattern rules.
authorityMonitoringLaw.runtimeStatus: METADATA_SEED_ONLY. No automated background workers or network pollers are executed in this gate.
